nearest_neighbours_do_not: EO-INSURE's public description attributes separation to multi-temporal within-field anomaly comparison against the pre-event baseline plus met data, not to embedding-space nearest-neighbour spatial twins (AlphaEarth-style) drawn from other fields as counterfactual controls.
